status.container: The candidate passed package checks and the Flash-Next TP1 serving smoke on November 19. Versioned image promotion is pending.

source.candidate_note: The accepted runtime candidate: two functional commits above the published 3.1.6 source, carrying the Anthropic thinking.display="updates" acceptance and the Flash-Next multi-GPU expandable-segments default, plus the draft public notes. The release preparation on top of it moves version assets, image defaults and documentation only; no runtime code changes here.
source.image_source_note: The image was built and tested from the packaging PR head. Later publication records document that same digest.

submissions.note: Author Pennyroyal, co-author JustinTong0323, whose upstream fix is the source; authorship is preserved in the commit.

upstream_ports.summary: A narrow backport: the display Literal and the compatibility warning. The local backend has no per-step reasoning patch knob, so reasoning emission is unchanged and ordinary reasoning still streams.

changes.summary: Claude Code can send thinking.display="updates" with adaptive or enabled thinking on /v1/messages. The server accepts the request and streams ordinary reasoning.
profiles: Both profiles on the Anthropic /v1/messages route

changes.summary: Multi-GPU Flash-Next launchers default CUDA expandable segments off. An explicit allocator setting reaching the multi-GPU startup process takes precedence.
profiles: Flash-Next native MTP, FR-Spec and DFlash2 launches at TP2 and above

changes.summary: Version assets, container image defaults and release documentation: configs/pennyroyal/pennyroyal.version, penny_config.DEFAULT_IMAGE, compose.yaml, launch/run.sh (default and its help line) and docker's .env.example say 3.1.7, and test_penny_recipes.RELEASED_IMAGE holds them to one release. Public policy is unchanged: tiered stays the width-policy default, 27B DFlash2 stays qualified, Flash-Next DFlash2 stays alpha, and the documented extra host RAM for the draft cache is retained.
profiles: Every profile and both launch routes

validation.review: The two fixes are the accepted runtime scope of this release; the release preparation adds no runtime claim. Codex owns independent review and acceptance of the assets commit.
validation.cpu: Candidate acceptance: 122 CPU tests with 15 subtests passed on 112870adb0, covering the display Literal and warning paths, the TP_SIZE-gated allocator export on all six Flash-Next entry points, the alias precedence and the 27B exception.
validation.serving: Both native TP1 profiles, Flash-Next with native NEXTN MTP and 27B with DFlash2, returned HTTP 200 for both streaming Anthropic cases, streamed ordinary reasoning, and completed naturally with the NIXL storage tier off.
validation.tp2: No TP2 hardware test was run. Maintainer TP2 qualification stays open and the release notes ask anyone with two RTX PRO 6000s to report a TP_SIZE=2 start, graph capture and served request in issue #161.
validation.performance: No new measurements are claimed for this release; the dated rows in RESULTS.md stay as recorded and are not restated here.
validation.dependencies: No baseline or pin change: docker/pennyroyal/native-baseline.json stays as published for 3.1.6, with the same 231 recorded distributions, and no dependency upgrade is included. The upstream SGLang package version is independent of the Penny Royal release version and is unchanged here.
validation.public_main: PRs #172, #173 and #174 passed Contributor checks. The candidate image is from the tested head of #174.
validation.release_setup: Penny ran 327 setup and recipe tests, 41 container-launch and startup identity checks, and 87 Anthropic tests with 15 subtests. On thegrid the candidate CPU PLE preparation suite passed 21 tests and 9 subtests with the unchanged optional plugin from the published 3.1.6 image on its import path.

container.package_checks: Dependency parity, source identity, compiled SM120 module, optional PLE reader and NIXL POSIX FILE/DRAM support passed.
container.serving: Flash-Next TP1 on one RTX PRO 6000, public tiered NEXTN, medium reasoning, 32 GB HiCache and NIXL. Streamed generation and two parallel tool calls passed. Both adaptive and enabled Anthropic thinking requests with display=updates returned HTTP 200, streamed reasoning, answered correctly and ended with end_turn.
